summary.text: T'wina Nobles represents the 28th Legislative District, which includes Fircrest, University Place, Lakewood, Steilacoom, DuPont and Joint Base Lewis-McChord, in the Washington State Senate. Her official biography says she chairs the Higher Education & Workforce Development Committee and is vice chair of the Early Learning & K-12 Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Nobles attended Tacoma Community College before transferring to the University of Puget Sound, where she earned her undergraduate degree and a Master of Arts in Teaching, according to her official biography.
It says she taught at Stadium and Lincoln high schools and has served on the University Place School Board since 2016.
The page says that when she was first sworn in, in 2021, she was the first Black state senator to serve in a decade.
It says she moved to the district when her family was stationed at Joint Base Lewis-McChord, now lives in Fircrest, and has addressed broadband access for students.
